Program Snapshot

15 Credits

Learn how to apply entrepreneurial principles, innovation, and strategic problem-solving to your future in the technology field.

Why Minor in Technology Entrepreneurship at New York Tech?

The College of Engineering and Computing Sciences has teamed up with the School of Management and the Entrepreneurship and Technology Innovation Center (ETIC), to create a minor that will teach you how to launch your own technology-based enterprises.  

You’ll apply entrepreneurial principles of innovation and strategic problem-solving to a technology field while gaining increased confidence to form and work in collaborative teams; understand the processes to get from developed technology concepts or new ideas to the formation of a startup; and foundational knowledge of how to find financial resources to form a viable company. 

Opportunities for applied research, technology implementation, and product development, as well as exposure to enterprise building, venture capital, and corporate partners are available and encouraged. Featuring enhanced learning with a common set of courses and electives available across majors and demographic groups, this integrated program provides access to opportunities with industry, laboratories, and the full resources available at the ETIC, including its three labs in IT and Cybersecurity, Green and Energy Technologies, and Bioengineering and Medical Devices. 

You’ll have a dedicated advisor to assist you in course selection. This minor enhances technology entrepreneurship learning while fostering a collaborative environment where you’ll learn to work across disciplines. 

Program Details

Learn how to add the Technology Entrepreneurship Minor.  

  • Complete the Application to Declare an Undergraduate Minor. 
  • Bring the signed copy to Xun Yu, Harry Schure Hall, room 115, or scan and email to jdoe@nyit.edu, for review and signature. 
  • Bring the completed form to the Office of the Registrar.
